title: NK6130 VIP Corn (NK6130 Viptera): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: NK6130 VIP Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: NK6130 VIP corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon and Mindanao. About 105 days to harvest, 8.9 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: NK6130 VIP corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as NK6130 Viptera. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2025 as NSIC 2025 GMCn 101. Syngenta Crop Protection AG bred it. It takes about 105 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 8.89 tonnes per hectare in the trials (10.58 in Luzon, 7.2 in Mindanao).

blocks.text: Key facts about NK6130 VIP corn
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

NK6130 VIP corn takes about 105 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 8.89 t/ha beats the average of its group, 8.13. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 105 days in national trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 16 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 82.82 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

**Traits in the seed:** The VIP trait, sold under Syngenta's Protek Todo banner against fall armyworm and other corn caterpillars. Its page does not list the gene events.
**Where:** Registered for Luzon and Mindanao.
Plant about 224 cm tall in national trials.
Ear about 16 cm long.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: on Syngenta's current Philippine corn list as the VIP version of NK6130, under its Protek Todo banner. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant NK6130 VIP corn

It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is NK6130 Viptera the same as NK6130 VIP?
items.a: Yes. NK6130 Viptera is another name for NK6130 VIP, registered as NSIC 2025 GMCn 101. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 105 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 8.89 tonnes per hectare in the trials (10.58 in Luzon, 7.2 in Mindanao). Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of NK6130 VIP?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
